snapshots.bodySample: 252490 RSS Feed en-us Steam News RSS POWER TRIP <p class="bb_paragraph"></p><div onclick="javascript:ReplaceWithYouTubeEmbed( this );" data-youtube="&quot;ynUzYLpvmXs" class="sharedFilePreviewYouTubeVideo"><img class="sharedFilePreviewYouTubeVideo" src="https://steamcommunity.com/public/shared/images/responsive/youtube_16x9_placeholder.gif"/><iframe src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/&quot;ynUzYLpvmXs?fs=1&modestbranding=1&rel=0" allowFullScreen="1" frameBorder="0"></iframe></div><p class="bb_paragraph"></p><div class="bb_h2">PLAYER MAINTAINED MONUMENTS</div><p class="bb_paragraph"></p><p class="bb_paragraph">This month we're releasing a set of features we call Player Maintained Monuments - tying together our existing monuments in new and interesting ways while pushing players to interact with each other in the process.</p><p class="bb_paragraph"></p><p class="bb_paragraph"></p><div class="bb_h2">POWERING UP THE POWER PLANT</div><p class="bb_paragraph"></p><p class="bb_paragraph">Using new Heavy Fuses, the power plant can be fired back up to unlock several new gameplay features for everyone around the island.</p><p class="bb_paragraph"><img src="https://files.facepunch.com/martynchapman/2026/August/rust_powerfuses_4_1080_jpg.jpg style=box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;" crossorigin="anonymous" /></p><p class="bb_paragraph">Heavy Fuses can be found as loot and must be inserted into the new special fuse boxes located at the power plant. Not everything will be unlocked all at once - some things connected to the power plant require more fuses than others to become functional.</p><p class="bb_paragraph"><img src="https://files.facepunch.com/martynchapman/2026/August/rust_powerfuses_3_1080_jpg.jpg style=box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;" crossorigin="anonymous" /></p><p class="bb_paragraph">Once the power plant has started providing power, the powerline poles with transformers (the white cylinder-looking things) which appear alongside roads can now provide power for electrical circuits. snapshots.title: POE2 Steam news feed
snapshots.bodySample: 2694490 RSS Feed en-us Steam News RSS Path of Exile 2 ExileCon Qualifiers Begin Next Week It's finally happening! The ExileCon Path of Exile 2 Qualifiers kick off next week, culminating in a live final where the top racers from all four qualifier events will compete for the championship title in New Zealand.<br><br>The competition will take place on the following dates, with ZiggyD and Raiz serving as your hosts throughout the event:<br><br><b>Path of Exile 2 Qualifier Event Times and Dates</b><br><ul class="bb_ul"><li> Qualifier One - August 6 2PM PDT<br></li><li> Qualifier Two - August 13 2PM PDT<br></li><li> Qualifier Three - August 20 2PM PDT<br></li><li> Qualifier Four - August 27 2PM PDT</li></ul>If you're participating in the event, please make sure that your Path of Exile account is linked to your Twitch account. You can do this by logging into your account on the website, then clicking <a class="bb_link" href="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.pathofexile.com%2Fmy-account%2Fconnections" target="_blank" rel=" noopener" >here</a>.<br><br>To join a qualifier event, click the "Join" button for the race on the Character Select screen. You'll then be prompted to create a character. Once you've entered the game, your character will remain stationary until the race officially begins.<br><br>In each Path of Exile 2 qualifier event, players will race to become the first to defeat Tavakai in Act Four within a Solo Self-Found Runes of Aldur event featuring a fixed layout. While this is not a Hardcore event, dying carries a significant penalty: after each death, you won't be able to move your character for two and a half minutes before continuing the race.<br><br>The qualifier events are open to both PC and console players. However, the live finale at ExileCon will be played on PC. Competitors will be able to bring their .build files along with their preferred gaming peripherals with them to ExileCon for use during the finale.<br><br>You can find the full ruleset <a class="bb_link" href="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.pathofexile.com%2Fforum%2Fview-thread%2F3976136" target="_blank" rel=" noopener" >here</a>.<br><br><b>Prizes</b><br>The first player to kill Tavakai in each event will receive the following:<br><ul class="bb_ul"><li> Flights to Auckland, New Zealand for the weekend of ExileCon<br></li><li> Accommodation in Auckland for the weekend of ExileCon<br></li><li> Entrance into the ExileCon Path of Exile 2 Race Finale<br></li><li> An Ultra VIP ExileCon ticket<br></li><li> A Demig
